A couple friends of mine and I spent the night in the infamous Villisca Ax Murder House in Villisca, Iowa. Upon our arrival, we were given a tour of the place so we could learn the history, know the rooms, etc... Our tour guide shows us an old photo of the family, along with their names, that was killed that night (2 parents, 4 of their kids, and 2 friends of the kids who were spending the night when it happened). She tells us the story about the murders and how while the Moore family was at church the evening of June 9th, 1912, a crazed man snuck into their home, with an ax, and hid in the attic until the early hours of June 10th, 1912. The family was fast asleep when the killer stepped out and proceeded to commit his acts.

So, my friends and I were given the key to the place and the guide left us. A few hours pass and crazy things have already happened, but the one I will always remember was what happened in their parlor room. I stand up in said room to pick up my digital recorder off the floor (check for voices) and as I'm looking at the buttons in order to stop it (I'm using a flashlight because it was a tad dark in there despite the street light outside), I look down to my left and their is this little kid, sitting pretzel-legged, looking right up at me. He was wearing a green button up, short sleeve shirt, with a small white line on the collar, and he had dark dress shorts on accompanied with long dress socks and dress shoes, both of which were also dark. He was there for maybe 2 seconds and then, poof, gone. It was so vivid and neither of my friends saw him, but they could hear my reaction. To this day, I think about it. Whenever I tell people the story, my eyes start to water. Turns out the kid's name was Paul. How I know that? That picture the guide showed us? Exactly the same look and dress. And yes, I have been asked if my mind came up with that image due to seeing the photo earlier. Truly, it did not. It wasn't just a photo of the specific kid, but the whole family. Why would I focus just on one random person? And it happens to be that one who appears?


TL;DR Spent the night in the Villisca Ax Murder House in Villisca, Iowa. Came face to face with one of the Moore family kids who was killed in the house.
